name: cve_backport_bench_1
description: A dataset for evaluating models' ability to backport or produce security patches related to CVEs (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures). It measures code models' performance at generating correct, security-preserving patches or fixes for older codebases or targeted vulnerable snippets. Tasks emphasize realistic code-editing/patch-generation scenarios and correctness of applied fixes.
evaluation_method: exact_match and functional correctness (where available, e.g., test-suite or semantic verification); otherwise exact_match on reference patches
reputation: Niche, practical dataset addressing secure patch/backport scenarios; modest adoption primarily among code-model and software-security researchers.
